mapper.select: select count(total_number) as total_number from tb_order o inner join tb_order_detail od on o.id = od.order_id where o.is_deleted = 0 and o.status = 2 and od.status = 1 and o.commodity_type != 1 and o.user_id = #{userId} and od.commodity_type_code = #{commodityTypeCode}
select count(1) from tb_order where status = 2 and user_id = #{orderUserId} and is_deleted = 0 and trial_order = 0 and order_type != 0 and level > 1 and total_price > 1 and commodity_type = 1 limit 1
SELECT active_tenant_id FROM tb_user WHERE id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
